A recommends headings and then calls them optional at seven rules, which weakens its own advice. B reworded two rules, but it says so and the meaning doesn't change. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers recommend a list, explain clearly why a table would leave a single real column, and avoid inventing columns.
